name: io.github.quartzondev/qr-branding
title: QR Branding
description: Generate branded, scan-validated QR codes (manual, AI, templates, Wi-Fi, vCard, geo).

environmentVariables.name: QR_BRANDING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your QR Branding API key (qrb_…), from https://qr-branding.com/dashboard/keys. Requires a Studio pack.

environmentVariables.name: QR_BRANDING_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway base URL. Defaults to https://qr-branding.com.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Your QR Branding API key (qrb_…). `Authorization: Bearer qrb_…` is accepted too. Optional: without a key the remote server runs a keyless trial (no AI, PNG up to 720 px, 20 tool calls per day per network).
